# sortitout: Santhosh Kumar S

> Santhosh Kumar S is a software developer in India who builds AI and document tools for scholarly publishing. sortitout is his personal project name: his own lab, built in his own time. It is not a registered company and not affiliated with any employer. First product: Resolve.

## About
- Software developer: 3 years of production experience building AI and document-intelligence systems for scholarly publishing workflows, after 2 years in industrial IoT.
- Works with Python, FastAPI, Node.js, React, Postgres and Docker; LLM deployment (serverless APIs, cloud and self-hosted), retrieval and evaluation; PDF layout and reference extraction, OCR, structured XML and citation checks.
- Education: MCA, MGR University (2023); B.Sc. Electronics & Communication, Periyar University (2019).

## Product: Resolve
- A knowledge base for publishing offices. It answers questions with citations, using only each journal's latest stylesheet and ticket answers a lead has approved, and says so when it does not know.
- A revised stylesheet retires the previous version; one journal's rules never appear in another's (enforced in the database).
- Evaluated on 168 trap questions over synthetic data: 95.8% correct, no stale or wrong-journal answers.
- Has an MCP server with OAuth sign-in so AI tools such as Claude can use it with the signed-in person's access.
- Independent project, synthetic data only; no employer code or data. Accounts are by request.
- App: https://app.sortitouthq.com
- Source (MIT): https://github.com/sandeess/resolve
- Architecture and design notes: https://github.com/sandeess/resolve/blob/main/docs/engineering.md
- Privacy and data retention: https://github.com/sandeess/resolve/blob/main/docs/privacy-and-zdr.md
